name: Moovila API Patterns
description: The Moovila tool surface as exposed through Conduit: the 19 read-only report tools and their tiers, the bring-your-own-client OAuth connection and the X-Moovila-Access-Token header Conduit injects, offset/limit paging with the 100-record cap and truncation notes, lastChangedDate incremental pulls, GUID validation, the record shapes (Project, ProjectBudget, Task, TimeEntry, User, labor type), and the error vocabulary.
